mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is "https everywhere, no exceptions": internal hosts are not exempt, so plain HTTP is not permitted for them and all connections, internal or external, must use HTTPS. This sits alongside the standing decision that certificate verification stays enabled on all builds.
EOF
